title: Samson
source_text:
Lo+šamiʕono hayo. 
Šamiʕono i... Šəmšə́m gaboro, hayo šamiʕalla. 
Balki háwoyo. 
Šəmšə́m balki háyoyo. 
Šəmšə́m gaboro gabórowa. 
Noše lo+qodarwa aʕle, ḥokamwa ʕal i+qriṯo kula, noše lápwayle, xašuno. 
Ŭ hiye, əšme Šəmšə́m gabóroyo. 
Bu+yawmo lḥasyo Benyamen Aktaš bu+talavәziṑn ŭ dayroyo Samyel miralle. 
Miralle, әmmi, ánnaqqa... miralle... 
Əmmi, Šəmšə́m gaboro, kəmmallux, gabórowa ŭ ġắlăbe ḥokamwa, ḥokamwa. 
E, áydarbo ḥokam? 
Áydarbo, lo áydarbo, məš‿šəkl?
Ánnaqqa hanək ag+gundiyayḏe dlo+qudriwa aʕle, mərre, ‘Gdobínale k̇ắčәk̇e. 
Malawšínala ǧule xŭššәk̇at, ṭrosaymo ruḥa ebe dmohaḷḷa. 
Dlo i+k̇ačk̇e saymo ʕalā́ǧ mine, aḥna layban aʕle’.
Edi hak̇a hayo, hak̇a lo, lo+kuḏʕono, ánnaqqa əmmi i+k̇ačk̇e əšma Dalílawa. 
Əšma Dalílawa, lawšowa ǧule šafire. 
Ŭ səmla ruḥa ebe, ŭ híyaste šafə́rtowa. 
Әmmi, səmla ruḥa ebe, nafəl lebe eba, mḥawal aʕma, mhirole.
Mhirole, mhirole. 
Ba ánnaqqa kəmmole, kəmmo, ‘I+gaboruṯayḏux bmənyo? 
Gabórohat, i+gaboruṯayḏux bmənyo?’ 
Komər, ‘E, məḥ‿ḥarulax mini?’
Gdəmmo, ‘Bi+maknəšto’, gəzzá məqḏo i+maknəšto. 
Gdəmmo, ‘Bәflā́n médeyo’, g̊saymo zyono.
Kohné šato ŭ tarte ŭ tlaṯ, kofəlto bəṯre. 
Kəmmo, kəmmo, ‘Maḷḷi, be i+gaboruṯayḏux bmənyo?’ 
Ġắlăbe kəmbasmóleste.
(Lə+g̊šətyono, lə+g̊šətyono). 
Ŭ ġắlăbe kəmbasmole ŭ saymo ruḥa ebe ŭ ṣaydole maʕrifa ŭ omar, ‘Ḥurma, i+gaboruṯayḏi b̥ṣáʕriyo, b̥sawki, b̥ṣaʕri’.
‘Mu+yawmo dhawino lo+qəṣli. 
Ono, ṣaʕri, u+k̇očak̇ d Alóhoyo. 
Lo+qəṣli ṣaʕri’. 
Yarәx ak̇+k̇aziyayḏe, ha háwxawayne, nəḥtiwa harke. 
Hedik̇a qā‿maštela, maštela hak̇a wiski, hak̇a be məš‿šəkl, maštela ŭ maštela. 
Ánnaqqa komaḥwowa i+ǧәzok̇ayḏa biḏa ŭ u+qudaḥ biḏe, biḏa.
Ŭ kobole, komaštole obole, maštole obole hul dhawi behə́š, hawi behə́š, mədla lu+šalfo, ánnaqqa ṣərta maḥwewa hawxa. 
Ṣə́rtaste maḥwewa, mḥela u+šalfo ʕal ak̇+k̇azikayḏe, kulle qṭiʕila. 
Mḥela u+šalfo ʕal ak̇+k̇azikayḏe, qṭiʕila, ŭ azzayo, mašrat hawxa mʕalela i+parda.
Maḥwowa, maḥwela hawxa, mʕalela i+parda ŭ səmla lam+morayḏa hawxa. 
Ánnaqqa mballe aq+qayse, palq, palq, palq, palq! 
Komoḥe bruḥe, laybe qōm. 
I+gaboruṯayḏe azzá, mofaqqe at+tarte+ʕaynayḏe, mofaqqe at+tarte+ʕaynayḏe, ŭ maḥatte aʕleee, mqaṣqaṣṣe. 
Moṣarre, mḥalaqqe zənǧər, u+zənǧər b̥xwa maḥwewa. 
Zənǧər mani a+ḥlime. 
Ḥa larke ŭ larke, mballe lu+ḥaps. 
Mballe lu+ḥappəs, fāš be məqqa bu+ḥappəs hul dyarəx ṣaʕre. 
Lə+mballe bīr d̥qayṣile, ṣaʕre disa yarəx xud meqəm. 
. Ŭ mofaqqe, ínaqqa dmofaqqe mu+ḥappəs, omar, әmmi... Səmme ánnaqqa ʕazima, səmme ʕazima bu+hayklo, latimi kulle lәḥḏoḏe. 
Mtarasle u+xwarzayḏe, mtarasle u+xwarzayḏe, omar, ‘Zux be man ŭ manne bu+hayklo?’ 
Azzeyo omar, ‘Ḥolo!’ 
Omar, ‘Ha!’ 
‘Flānkás ŭ behvānkás ŭ fəltankás’ hanәk dәmʕan<atte>… dhawxa səmme ebe, kulle kanné bu+hayklo.
Kanné kulle bu+hayklo. 
Omar, ‘De mbali! 
Smaxli li+stune du+hayklo ŭ dʕar!’
Azzé mbele. 
Hooo, komqašməri aʕle, ʕayne kanné biṭe, iḏoṯe kanné mәṣre, ŭ zənǧər harke ŭ harke, ha hawxa kanné iḏe mәṣre bu+zənǧər.
 Ŭ azzé mbele, sməxle ḥase li+stune du+hayklo ha hawxa, ŭ u+zʕuro nafəq.
Ŭ ánnaqqa hənnək koguḥki mqašməri aʕle, koguḥki aʕle. 
Hăma səmle hawxa, naqqa omar ‘mrrrrr’ u+hayklo. 
Qṭile kulle ŭ qṭile rúḥeste. 
Hawxa šamiʕono.

items.value: Mtarasle u+xwarzayḏe, mtarasle u+xwarzayḏe, omar, ‘Zux be man ŭ manne bu+hayklo?’
He sent his nephew, he sent his nephew, he said, ‘Go, who and who are in the nave?’

sentences.source_line: Azzeyo omar, ‘Ḥolo!’
sentences.translation: He went, he says, ‘Uncle!’

sentences.source_line: Omar, ‘Ha!’
sentences.translation: He says, ‘Here!’

sentences.source_line: ‘Flānkás ŭ behvānkás ŭ fəltankás’ hanәk dәmʕan<atte>… dhawxa səmme ebe, kulle kanné bu+hayklo.
sentences.translation: Such-and-such, and so-and-so, and what’s-his-name’ those who were ang<ry> … who had done so to him, they’re all there in the nave.

items.value: ‘Flānkás ŭ behvānkás ŭ fəltankás’ hanәk dәmʕan<atte>… dhawxa səmme ebe, kulle kanné bu+hayklo.
Such-and-such, and so-and-so, and what’s-his-name’ those who were ang<ry> … who had done so to him, they’re all there in the nave.

sentences.source_line: Kanné kulle bu+hayklo.
sentences.translation: They’re all there in the nave.

items.value: They’re all there in the nave.

sentences.source_line: Omar, ‘De mbali!
sentences.translation: He says, ‘Take me!

sentences.source_line: Smaxli li+stune du+hayklo ŭ dʕar!’
sentences.translation: Prop me against the pillar of the nave and go back!’

items.value: Prop me against the pillar of the nave and go back!’

sentences.source_line: Azzé mbele.
sentences.translation: He went to take him.

sentences.source_line: Hooo, komqašməri aʕle, ʕayne kanné biṭe, iḏoṯe kanné mәṣre, ŭ zənǧər harke ŭ harke, ha hawxa kanné iḏe mәṣre bu+zənǧər.
sentences.translation: Oooh, they mock at him, his eyes, there they are, burst, his hands, there they are bound, and a chain, here and here, just like so, there are his hands, tied with the chain.

items.value: Hooo, komqašməri aʕle, ʕayne kanné biṭe, iḏoṯe kanné mәṣre, ŭ zənǧər harke ŭ harke, ha hawxa kanné iḏe mәṣre bu+zənǧər.
Oooh, they mock at him, his eyes, there they are, burst, his hands, there they are bound, and a chain, here and here, just like so, there are his hands, tied with the chain.

sentences.source_line: Ŭ azzé mbele, sməxle ḥase li+stune du+hayklo ha hawxa, ŭ u+zʕuro nafəq.
sentences.translation: He went to take him, he propped his back against the pillar of the nave just like so, and the boy left.

items.value: Ŭ azzé mbele, sməxle ḥase li+stune du+hayklo ha hawxa, ŭ u+zʕuro nafəq.
He went to take him, he propped his back against the pillar of the nave just like so, and the boy left.

sentences.source_line: Ŭ ánnaqqa hənnək koguḥki mqašməri aʕle, koguḥki aʕle.
sentences.translation: And now then, they laugh to mock at him, they laugh at him.

items.value: Ŭ ánnaqqa hənnək koguḥki mqašməri aʕle, koguḥki aʕle.
And now then, they laugh to mock at him, they laugh at him.

sentences.source_line: Hăma səmle hawxa, naqqa omar ‘mrrrrr’ u+hayklo.
sentences.translation: So he did like so, at once the nave goes ‘timber’.

items.value: Hăma səmle hawxa, naqqa omar ‘mrrrrr’ u+hayklo.
So he did like so, at once the nave goes ‘timber’.

sentences.source_line: Qṭile kulle ŭ qṭile rúḥeste.
sentences.translation: He killed everyone and killed himself too.

items.value: He killed everyone and killed himself too.

sentences.source_line: Hawxa šamiʕono.
sentences.translation: I heard it like so.
